children: Germany's top industrial union, IG Metall, is demanding a 5% pay rise for 3.7 million workers in the engineering sector ahead of collective bargaining talks set to start next month, the union said on Wednesday.
"We're entering the negotiations with a combative sense of realism," IG Metall president Christiane Benner said.
"Making concessions gets us nowhere," she added, calling for secure employment and profit-sharing instead of crisis rhetoric.
